content:
Meet patients on the channel they already use

For many clinics in India, WhatsApp outperforms email and even SMS for confirmations—especially when messages include the doctor name, clinic location pin, and a one-tap reschedule option.

Message design principles

  • Lead with the clinic name and appointment date/time in the first line
  • Include Google Maps link or landmark for first-time visitors
  • Offer one clear action: confirm, reschedule, or call the desk
  • Keep prep instructions to three bullets maximum

Suggested timing

  1. Immediately after booking: confirmation + intake link
  2. 48 hours before: reminder with address
  3. 3 hours before: final nudge for same-day traffic

Consent and professionalism

Capture messaging consent during registration and explain what types of messages patients will receive. Avoid promotional content in clinical reminder threads—keep transactional messages separate from marketing campaigns.
